detail.longDescription:
Kagi Assistant combines Kagi Search with 30+ leading AI models, giving you the best of search and AI in one fast, ad-free app.

Get current, source-backed answers, choose the right model for any task, and work without ads, tracking, or engagement-driven noise.

• Combine Kagi Search with leading AI models
Kagi Assistant pairs the world’s best search engine with state-of-the-art AI models for current, source-backed answers.

• Choose from 30+ AI models
Switch models at any point in a conversation without starting over.

• Keep conversations private
Your conversations are never used to train AI models, and your account information is never shared with model providers. Threads are deleted after 24 hours by default, with controls for changing retention.

• Create custom assistants
Configure assistants for research, coding, writing, or other workflows using custom instructions, models, web access, and Kagi Lenses.

• Go quick or go deep
Use Quick Assistant for straightforward questions or Research Assistant for complex, multi-step investigations.

• Work your way
Edit prompts, switch models mid-conversation, upload files, and organize threads into folders.

Model and feature availability varies by subscription plan.

By using Kagi Assistant, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

Privacy Policy: https://kagi.com/privacy  
Terms of Use: https://kagi.com/privacy#Terms-of-use
